title: Windows CI names a test that hangs
goal: The kb-tests-windows job passes -o faulthandler_timeout to the tests, so a hanging test's stack is in the job log instead of silence until the job timeout.
notes: The Windows suite takes 895 s on 8 local workers, and three tests run past 300 s without hanging (TK-5vfbfjht). On the 2-worker hosted runner a faulthandler_timeout under the slowest test prints stacks for tests that are only slow, and the job timeout needs room for a run well over 16 minutes.
